purpose: Assess NZD/RBNZ reaction-function feasibility under the same PIT/OOS discipline used for AUD without substituting revised history or vendor data.

macro.source: Stats NZ archived CPI and Labour Market Statistics quarterly releases

front_end.source: Reserve Bank of New Zealand Wholesale interest rates (B2)
front_end.series: Secondary market government bond closing yield - 2 year
front_end.basis_note: RBNZ states that from 25 August 2025 the source changed to NZFMA closing rates and both historical data and future publications were transitioned to the closing-rate basis with a one-day publication lag.

fx.source: ECB G8 historical daily reference-rate matrix

predeclared_reaction_contract.hawkish: CPI YoY rises and latest-known unemployment falls
predeclared_reaction_contract.dovish: CPI YoY falls and latest-known unemployment rises
predeclared_reaction_contract.outcome: signed NZD equal-weight G8 basket return t5->t25
predeclared_reaction_contract.oos: first 40% chronology initial, remaining 60% forward OOS

decision.reason: Official data are identified but cannot currently be materialized reproducibly from the research runner. Revised macro history, vendor rates, or runtime snapshots must not be substituted merely to obtain a replay result.
decision.resume_when: Official Stats NZ first-release panel and RBNZ B2 2-year history can be materialized with source hashes/provenance under a reproducible access path.
